description:
The zero-warning and no-unsafe bars move from the gate script and crate-root attributes into the Cargo manifests, so a bare `cargo clippy` reproduces them.

## Background

No `[lints]` or `[workspace.lints]` table exists in `Cargo.toml`, `crates/jit/Cargo.toml` or `crates/server/Cargo.toml`, and the repository has no `clippy.toml`. The bar exists only as `-D warnings` inside `scripts/cargo-ci.sh`. `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` sits on four roots (`crates/jit/src/lib.rs`, `crates/jit/src/main.rs`, `crates/server/src/lib.rs`, `crates/server/src/main.rs`), so integration-test crates are not covered. A scratch-crate probe showed `[lints.rust] warnings = "deny"` makes `cargo clippy` fail on clippy warn-level lints and makes plain `cargo build`/`cargo test` fail on rustc warnings, so no separate clippy group is needed. The MSRV (1.97) supports workspace lint inheritance.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The root `Cargo.toml` declares `[workspace.lints.rust]` with `warnings = "deny"` and `unsafe_code = "deny"`, and both `crates/jit/Cargo.toml` and `crates/server/Cargo.toml` declare `[lints] workspace = true`.
- [hard] REQ-02: No `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` attribute remains in `crates/`, and prose that cites that attribute as the enforcement mechanism (`AGENTS.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, the comment in `crates/server/Cargo.toml`) names the workspace lint table instead.
- [hard] REQ-03: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` with no extra flags exits zero on the tree and non-zero when any target, integration tests included, introduces a warning.

## Notes

GitHub CI runs clippy with `--all-features`, unlike the gate; aligning the two is out of scope. Existing local `#[allow(...)]` attributes keep working. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Encode the zero-warning bar in workspace lints
